key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 50-65% at $40-$100/bbl (competitive deepwater terms; low royalty is key incentive)
75% cost oil cap per contract year
35% petroleum income tax (Namibia Income Tax Act petroleum rate)
50-65% government profit oil (R-factor based; starts at 50% state share increasing with profitability; NAMCOR participation adds state economic interest)
5% (Namibia Petroleum Taxation Act: flat 5% royalty on production value for all petroleum)
NAMCOR (National Petroleum Corporation of Namibia) 10% carried interest (free through exploration; contributing from production phase)
